scope_note: Frozen publisher artifact documentation. CARD keys identify editorial contracts, not registered spells. Grouped variants retain their exact IDs in the linked cards. No installed-byte equality, official source revision, safe mutator or gameplay QA is asserted.

AGGREGATE:bootstrap-and-metadata.reason: Mod entrypoints, registration/config wiring, creative tab and archive metadata support documented consumers rather than introducing another spell or perk.

AGGREGATE:localization.reason: Localization names include legacy identifiers; translation keys do not create registry objects, new spells, attributes or gameplay systems.

AGGREGATE:auxiliary-presentation.reason: Legacy models and fallback artwork remain presentation support. Their names are not additional registered item identities and are not claimed unreachable by datapacks.
